_comment: Patient aliasing. A report matches a patient when its patient external id is in external_ids, OR the pet's given name matches `names` (matched as the leading word of the report's pet name, which reads '<NAME> <OWNER SURNAME>'). Owner is intentionally NOT a match key — one household has multiple pets, so matching by owner would merge different animals. Reports matching nothing get an auto-created patient keyed by external id. Edit this file and re-run `bin/pethud reimport --force` (Ruby) or `bin/pethud build-web` + reload (browser) to regroup.

patients.name: Iris
patients.notes: Same cat across two households; appears as IRIS REED and IRIS PARK.
